title: GeniL: A Multilingual Dataset on Generalizing Language

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting sentences containing nationality identity terms (e.g., French, Nigerian, Chinese) and stereotypical attributes from the multilingual mC4 corpus, and annotating whether the sentential context explicitly promotes or merely mentions a generalization.

Evaluating text based on the co-occurrence of geo-culturally situated identity terms and attributes (sourced from the SeeGULL dataset) to classify if the linguistic context reinforces cultural stereotypes.
Analyzing sentences containing religious identity terms and associated attributes to determine if the text acts to generalize and stereotype a religious group within different languages.
